contract bundle is reproducible.before:
- name: contract bundle is reproducible
        # Mirrored in server/gates.ps1 'contract bundle self-test' — change
        # both in the same commit. The public MMP contract bundle (contract/mmp/)
        # is cut by a publisher; two cuts of this tree must be byte-identical and
        # every file must match the lock, or a vendored copy could never be
        # drift-checked against the tree.
        run: python3 contract/mmp/publish.py --self-test

matrix contract drift check.before:
- name: matrix contract drift check
        # server/contract/matrix/ is cut from matrix/contract/ by
        # matrix/contract/publish.py, which writes contract.lock (a sha256 per
        # file, UTF-8/LF/no BOM). Ground rule 1 still holds: a copy plus
        # checks, no crate edge. Two proofs, and both run here: the copy must
        # equal a fresh cut (--check,
        # the lock's source commit ignored), and munarium-api-types'
        # matrix_contract test verifies every vendored file against the lock
        # independently. Mirrored in server/gates.ps1 and
        # matrix-ci.yml -- change all three in the same commit.
        working-directory: .
        run: |
          if [ ! -d server/contract/matrix ]; then
            echo "::error::server/contract/matrix is missing; cut it with: py matrix/contract/publish.py --out server/contract/matrix"
            exit 1
          fi
          python3 matrix/contract/publish.py --self-test
          python3 matrix/contract/publish.py --check server/contract/matrix
          echo "contract version: $(cat matrix/contract/VERSION)"

license gate (manifests, SPDX headers, l.before:
- name: license gate (manifests, SPDX headers, license texts)
        # The licence gate: the workspace and every crate declare Apache-2.0,
        # LICENSE / NOTICE / THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md exist, and every source file
        # that can carry an SPDX line does. check_license.py's docstring is the
        # rule list; --stamp adds a missing header. Mirrored in server/gates.ps1.
        run: python3 check_license.py

crate boundary check.before:
- name: crate boundary check
        # Mirrored in server/gates.ps1 'crate boundary check' — change
        # both in the same commit. Three machine-checked boundaries (dev-guide
        # §4 boundary table):
        #   munarium-core / munarium-access: never depend on sqlx/axum/tonic/reqwest/utoipa
        #   munarium-providers: never depends on a storage crate
        run: |
          for crate in munarium-core munarium-access; do
            deps=$(cargo tree -p "$crate" -e normal --prefix none | awk '{print $1}' | sort -u)
            for banned in sqlx axum tonic reqwest utoipa; do
              if echo "$deps" | grep -qx "$banned"; then
                echo "BOUNDARY VIOLATION: $crate depends on $banned"; exit 1
              fi
            done
          done
          deps=$(cargo tree -p munarium-providers -e normal --prefix none | awk '{print $1}' | sort -u)
          for banned in munarium-store-pg munarium-store-mem munarium-retrieval-pg; do
            if echo "$deps" | grep -qx "$banned"; then
              echo "BOUNDARY VIOLATION: munarium-providers depends on $banned"; exit 1
            fi
          done
          # munarium-api-types ships in the public contract bundle: it may depend on munarium-proto
          # and on nothing else of the workspace. The core <-> DTO conversions live
          # in munarium-api-conv.
          deps=$(cargo tree -p munarium-api-types --all-features -e normal --prefix none | awk '{print $1}' | sort -u)
          strays=$(echo "$deps" | grep -E '^munarium-' | grep -vx -E 'munarium-api-types|munarium-proto' || true)
          if [ -n "$strays" ]; then
            echo "BOUNDARY VIOLATION: munarium-api-types depends on a server crate:"; echo "$strays"; exit 1
          fi

retrieval boundary check.before:
- name: retrieval boundary check
        # Mirrored in server/gates.ps1 -- change both in the same commit.
        #
        # Cargo has no notion of "a dependency only the composition root may
        # name", so the retrieval boundary is enforced at source level:
        # munarium-server may reference munarium_retrieval_pg ONLY in state.rs,
        # where AppState constructs PgRetrieval and PgSourceStore. Without this
        # the extraction silently rots -- one `use munarium_retrieval_pg::` in
        # a new handler and PostgreSQL is the real interface again.
        run: |
          strays=$(grep -rln "munarium_retrieval_pg" src/munarium-server/src/                    | grep -v "^src/munarium-server/src/state.rs$" || true)
          if [ -n "$strays" ]; then
            echo "::error::munarium-server names munarium_retrieval_pg outside state.rs:"
            echo "$strays"
            echo "use munarium_retrieval::Retrieval instead; state.rs is the composition root."
            exit 1
          fi

datastore boundary check.before:
- name: datastore boundary check
        # Mirrored in server/gates.ps1 -- change both in the same commit.
        #
        # munarium-datastore must stay independently usable: no Axum, tonic,
        # SQLx, PostgreSQL, server config, auth or runbooks in its dependency
        # graph, and no munarium-core either. The premise is a crate
        # that can be lifted out of this workspace; a boundary nothing enforces
        # lasts until the first convenient import.
        run: |
          deps=$(cargo tree -p munarium-datastore -e normal --prefix none | awk '{print $1}' | sort -u)
          rc=0
          for banned in sqlx axum tonic reqwest utoipa munarium-core munarium-store-pg                         munarium-retrieval-pg munarium-server munarium-runbooks; do
            if echo "$deps" | grep -qx "$banned"; then
              echo "::error::munarium-datastore depends on $banned"; rc=1
            fi
          done
          exit $rc

additive-only migrations check.before:
- name: additive-only migrations check
        # no destructive DDL may ever enter the migration set
        run: |
          if grep -riE '^\s*(drop\s+(table|column)|alter\s+table\s+\S+\s+drop)' src/munarium-store-pg/migrations/ 2>/dev/null; then
            echo "DESTRUCTIVE DDL in migrations"; exit 1
          fi
